verdict.summary: Round 2 fixes the prior major finding. `resolve_lazy` now performs lexical resolution first, verifies an attached vector store against the graph before invoking the embedder, and only then embeds and searches. The stale-store regression test exercises the real `terse_to_sparql_with` path and asserts both `StaleStore` and zero embedder calls; complementary tests cover lexical success, no-store failure, and exactly one call when vector fallback runs. The freshness check is centralized, and `resolve_vector` has only the validated call site. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in the diff.
